tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The quoted price shall be firm and fixed and shall include all applicable costs, including transportation, delivery, loading, unloading, inspection, standard accessories, and GST. Registration, road tax, and insurance shall be included

The vehicle shall be supplied complete with all standard accessories, safety equipment, tool kit, spare wheel, first-aid box, fire extinguisher, emergency exit, speed governor, reverse parking buzzer, and other mandatory school bus safety features.
The purchaser reserves the right to inspect the vehicle before dispatch and upon delivery. The vehicle shall be accepted only after successful inspection and verification of all specifications.
The supplier shall provide the manufacturers standard warranty on the vehicle and all major components. Any defects noticed during the warranty period shall be rectified free of cost.
Payment shall be released only after successful delivery, inspection, acceptance of the vehicle, and submission of all required documents
The successful bidder shall furnish a Performance Security as specified in the tender before commencement of the supply.
The purchaser reserves the right to reject any bid that is incomplete, conditional, or does not conform to the technical specifications and tender requirements

Award of the contract and release of payment shall be subject to the availability of funds and approval by the competent authority. The Purchaser reserves the right to defer, reduce, or cancel the procurement, in whole or in part, if sufficient funds are not available, without incurring any liability to the bidders.
The offered vehicle shall be Mahindra Treo Zor (Electric) or equivalent model meeting or exceeding all the specified technical requirements.
The bidder shall supply brand new, unused, latest model Electric Three-Wheeler Solid Waste Collection Vehicles conforming to the technical specifications mentioned in the tender document.
The vehicle shall be supplied with Registration Certificate (RC), Comprehensive Insurance, Road Tax, Temporary/Permanent Registration, and all statutory approvals before delivery.
The bidder shall provide factory-fitted GPS tracking system with minimum one year data/SIM connectivity. The GPS shall support real-time tracking through web/mobile application.
The waste collection body shall be twin compartment type with separate Wet Waste and Dry Waste sections, leak-proof, corrosion-resistant, and fabricated using MS/FRP material.

The body shall be painted and branded as per the approved design of the Gram Panchayat/Swachh Bharat Mission, including Gram Panchayat name, Wet Waste, Dry Waste, Swachh Bharat logo and other required markings in Kannada.
The bidder shall deliver the vehicle in fully operational condition, complete with charger, tool kit, first aid box, fire extinguisher, user manual, and all standard accessories.
The bidder shall provide onsite demonstration and operational training to the Gram Panchayat staff at the time of delivery without any additional cost.
The vehicle shall have a minimum warranty of 3 years or manufacturers standard warranty, whichever is higher.
The traction battery shall carry a minimum warranty of 5 years or manufacturer standard warranty, whichever is higher.
During the warranty period, the bidder shall repair or replace any defective parts free of cost, including labour charges.
The bidder shall maintain adequate service facilities and availability of spare parts within Bengaluru urban throughout the warranty period
Any breakdown reported during the warranty period shall be attended within 24hours from the time of complaint.
If repairs require more than 7 days, the bidder shall provide an equivalent replacement vehicle until the original vehicle is restored, if demanded by the Tender Inviting Authority.
The successful bidder shall bear all expenses towards transportation, loading, unloading, registration, insurance, branding, GPS installation, and delivery up to the destination Gram Panchay
The Tender Inviting Authority reserves the right to inspect the vehicle at the manufacturer premises or dealership before dispatch, if required.
The supplied vehicle shall comply with all applicable CMVR, Motor Vehicles Act, AIS standards, BIS standards, and Government of India/State Government regulations in force.
Any deviation from the approved technical specifications without prior written approval of the Tender Inviting Authority shall lead to rejection of the vehicle.
Payment shall be released only after satisfactory inspection, successful demonstration, submission of all required documents, and acceptance by the Gram Panchayat.

The bidder shall not claim any additional payment for accessories, transportation, registration, insurance, branding, GPS installation, taxes, or any incidental expenses not specifically mentioned in the financial bid.
The decision of the Tender Inviting Authority regarding compliance with the specifications, quality, and acceptance of the vehicle shall be final and binding on the bidder.

The successful bidder shall, at the time of delivery, furnish all relevant documents, including the Registration Certificate (RC), Comprehensive Insurance Policy, Road Tax Paid Receipt, Battery Warranty Card, Vehicle Warranty Card, User Manual, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) Certificate, Tax Invoice, and GPS Installation Certificate. Delivery shall be considered complete only upon submission of all the above documents to the satisfaction of the Tender Inviting Authority.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment (s) similar to the type specified in the ‘Schedule of Requirements’ up to at least xxxx % of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after xxxxx and be in satisfactory operation for xxxxx months as on date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer , has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least xxxxx % of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least xxxxx months on the date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.

Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three/five years2 and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

To qualify for Award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last Three years satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than 10Lakh
Mandatory Satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least 1 similar nature of work 50 PERCENT of total cost of works.
Manufacturer Authorization Form as per Prescribed Format
